title: Out and about
description: Your day, hobbies, shopping, home, health, travel and making plans with friends.

lessons.title: Daily routine
lessons.tip: Time words usually come first: Buổi sáng tôi uống cà phê (In the morning I drink coffee). thường = usually, đang = right now, lúc = at (a time).

items.vi: Buổi sáng tôi thường uống cà phê.
items.en: In the morning I usually drink coffee.
alt: I usually drink coffee in the morning.

items.vi: Tôi đi làm lúc tám giờ.
items.en: I go to work at eight o'clock.
alt: I go to work at eight.
I go to work at 8 o'clock.
I leave for work at eight.

items.vi: Buổi trưa tôi ăn cơm với đồng nghiệp.
items.en: At noon I eat with my colleagues.
alt: I have lunch with my colleagues.
At noon I eat rice with my colleagues.
I eat lunch with my colleagues.
At lunchtime I eat with my colleagues.

items.note: nấu cơm: literally “cook rice”, i.e. cook a meal.

items.en: In the evening I watch movies.
alt: I watch movies in the evening.
In the evening I watch a movie.
I watch films in the evening.
In the evening I watch films.

items.vi: Tôi đi ngủ lúc mười một giờ.
items.en: I go to bed at eleven o'clock.
alt: I go to sleep at eleven.
I go to bed at eleven.
I go to sleep at eleven o'clock.

items.vi: Mỗi sáng tôi tập thể dục.

items.en: I shower and then brush my teeth.
alt: I take a shower, then brush my teeth.
I shower, then brush my teeth.
I take a shower and then brush my teeth.

items.vi: Chủ nhật tôi thường ngủ dậy muộn.
items.en: On Sundays I usually get up late.
alt: I usually get up late on Sundays.
On Sunday I usually wake up late.
I usually wake up late on Sundays.
items.note: muộn = late in the North (Southern: trễ).

items.vi: Hôm nay tôi bận cả ngày.
items.en: Today I am busy all day.
alt: I am busy all day today.

lessons.title: Hobbies
lessons.tip: thích + verb = like doing something: Tôi thích đọc sách. hay = often. Sở thích của bạn là gì? = What are your hobbies?

items.vi: Sở thích của bạn là gì?
Anh ấy chơi bóng đá rất giỏi.
alt: He is very good at football.

items.vi: Bạn có thích nghe nhạc không?
items.en: Do you like listening to music?
alt: Do you like to listen to music?

items.vi: Cuối tuần tôi hay đi bơi.
items.en: On weekends I often go swimming.
alt: I often go swimming on weekends.
At the weekend I often go swimming.
I often go swimming at the weekend.
I don't know how to sing.
items.note: biết + verb = know how to, can.

items.vi: Chúng mình đi xem phim nhé?
items.en: Shall we go to the movies?
alt: Shall we go see a movie?
Shall we go to the cinema?

items.vi: Bạn có hay đi du lịch không?

lessons.title: Shopping
lessons.tip: mặc = wear (clothes), đi = wear (shoes), đội = wear (a hat). mặc thử = try on. Northern: cỡ = size, mũ = hat.

items.vi: Tôi muốn mua một cái áo sơ mi.
items.en: I want to buy a shirt.
alt: I would like to buy a shirt.
I'd like to buy a shirt.

items.en: This shirt is a bit tight.
alt: This top is a bit tight.
This shirt is a little tight.
Do you have a bigger size?
Do you have a larger size?
This pair of shoes is very beautiful.

items.vi: Cửa hàng mở cửa đến mấy giờ?
items.en: Until what time is the shop open?
alt: What time does the shop close?
How late is the shop open?
Until when is the store open?
Until what time is the store open?

items.vi: Bạn có thể gói lại cho tôi không?
items.en: Can you wrap it for me?
alt: Could you wrap it for me?
Can you wrap it up for me?

items.vi: Cái mũ này bao nhiêu tiền?
alt: How much does this hat cost?

lessons.title: Colors
lessons.tip: Colours come after the noun: áo đỏ = red shirt. màu = colour. xanh can mean blue or green; xanh lá cây (leaf green) makes it clear.

items.vi: Tôi thích màu xanh lá cây.
Tôi muốn mua cái áo màu trắng.
items.en: I want to buy the white shirt.
alt: I want to buy a white shirt.
I would like to buy the white shirt.
I'd like to buy the white shirt.

items.vi: Con mèo của tôi màu đen.
Cái xe máy đỏ kia là của tôi.

alt: I don't like the color brown.
I don't like the colour brown.

lessons.title: At home
lessons.tip: Rooms: phòng khách (living room), phòng ngủ (bedroom), bếp (kitchen), nhà vệ sinh (toilet). Places: trên (on), dưới (under), trong (in).

items.vi: Nhà tôi có ba phòng ngủ.
alt: There are three bedrooms in my house.
My mother is in the kitchen.

items.en: The living room is very spacious.
alt: The living room is very big.
The living room is very large.

items.en: The key is on the table.
alt: The keys are on the table.

items.vi: Bạn sống ở chung cư à?
alt: Do you live in an apartment?
Do you live in an apartment building?
You live in an apartment building?

items.vi: Tôi thuê một căn hộ nhỏ.

items.en: The fridge is out of milk.
alt: There is no more milk in the fridge.
There's no more milk in the fridge.

items.vi: Con chó đang ngủ dưới gầm giường.
items.en: The dog is sleeping under the bed.
alt: The dog is asleep under the bed.

items.vi: Tối nay tôi phải dọn nhà.
items.en: Tonight I have to clean the house.
alt: I have to clean the house tonight.
I must clean the house tonight.
Tonight I must clean the house.

lessons.title: Health
lessons.tip: bị + problem = to suffer from something: Tôi bị ốm (I'm sick; ốm is Northern, Southern: bệnh), tôi bị đau đầu (I have a headache). nên = should.

items.note: thế at the end is a Northern question softener (Southern: vậy).

items.vi: Tôi bị sốt từ hôm qua.
items.en: I have had a fever since yesterday.
alt: I've had a fever since yesterday.

items.en: I need to see a doctor.

items.vi: Mỗi ngày uống thuốc hai lần.
items.en: Take the medicine twice a day.
alt: Take the medicine two times a day.
Take the medicine twice every day.
You should get a lot of rest.

items.vi: Tôi bị dị ứng với tôm.

alt: I hope you get well soon!

lessons.title: At the hotel
lessons.tip: đặt phòng = book a room, nhận phòng = check in, trả phòng = check out. đã … rồi = already done.

items.en: I have already booked a room.

alt: Do you have any free rooms?
Do you have any rooms available?

items.en: I want to stay three nights.
alt: I would like to stay three nights.
I'd like to stay for three nights.
I want to stay for three nights.
How much is it per night?

items.en: Does the room have air conditioning?
alt: Is there air conditioning in the room?
What time do I have to check out?
What time must I check out?

items.vi: Có bao gồm bữa sáng không?
Tôi gửi hành lý ở đây được không?
items.en: Can I leave my luggage here?
alt: May I leave my luggage here?
Can I store my luggage here?
Can I leave my bags here?

lessons.title: Making plans
lessons.tip: Suggest something with nhé: Đi ăn nhé! (Let's go eat!). Accept with Được! (Sure!). Decline politely: Tiếc quá, mình bận rồi. sẽ = will.

items.vi: Tối nay bạn có rảnh không?
Gặp nhau trước Nhà hát Lớn nhé.
items.en: Let's meet in front of the Opera House.
alt: Meet in front of the Opera House.
Let's meet in front of the opera house.
What a pity, I am busy.

items.vi: Mình sẽ đến muộn mười phút.
items.en: I will be ten minutes late.
alt: I'm going to be ten minutes late.

lessons.title: On the phone
lessons.tip: Answer the phone with A lô! Ask who is calling: Ai đấy ạ? (Northern đấy; Southern đó). nhắn tin = send a text message.

items.en: Can I speak to Lan, please?
alt: I'd like to speak to Lan.

items.vi: Chị ấy không có ở đây.
Tôi sẽ nhắn tin cho bạn.
alt: I will send you a message.

items.vi: Điện thoại tôi hết pin rồi.
alt: My phone is out of battery.
My phone has run out of battery.

items.vi: Số của bạn là bao nhiêu?

lessons.title: Travel
lessons.tip: đã = past, sẽ = future, chưa = not yet. Bạn đã đến … chưa? = Have you been to … yet? Answer: Rồi (yes, already) or Chưa (not yet).

items.vi: Bạn đã đến Hạ Long chưa?
items.en: Have you been to Hạ Long yet?
alt: Have you been to Ha Long yet?
Have you ever been to Hạ Long?
Have you been to Hạ Long?
Have you been to Ha Long?

items.vi: Tôi chưa đến đó bao giờ.
alt: I have never been there before.

items.vi: Năm sau tôi sẽ đi Sa Pa.
items.en: Next year I will go to Sa Pa.
alt: I will go to Sa Pa next year.
I'll go to Sa Pa next year.
Next year I'll go to Sapa.
Next year I'll go to Sa Pa.

items.vi: Hội An rất đẹp vào buổi tối.
items.en: Hội An is very beautiful in the evening.
alt: Hoi An is very beautiful in the evening.
Hội An is very beautiful at night.
Hoi An is very beautiful at night.

items.vi: Tôi muốn đi thuyền trên sông.
items.en: I want to take a boat on the river.
alt: I want to go on a boat on the river.
I would like to take a boat on the river.
I'd like to take a boat on the river.

items.vi: Bạn có thể chụp ảnh giúp tôi không?
items.en: Can you take a photo for me?
alt: Could you take a picture for me?
Can you take a picture for me?
Could you take a photo for me?
items.note: chụp ảnh = take a photo in the North (Southern: chụp hình).

items.vi: Vé vào cửa bao nhiêu tiền?
items.en: How much is the entrance ticket?
alt: How much is the admission ticket?
How much is the entry ticket?

items.vi: Chuyến đi này rất thú vị.
Tôi đã ở Việt Nam hai tuần.
items.en: I have been in Vietnam for two weeks.
alt: I've been in Vietnam for two weeks.
I was in Vietnam for two weeks.
I stayed in Vietnam for two weeks.
